package.welcome_message: Land in Aqaba, then 3 exploring days through Dead Sea (3 days).

trip.title: Dead Sea Escape
trip.summary: Arrival, then Dead Sea (3 days). Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

planning.strategy: You land at 15:58, so arrival night stays in Aqaba — hotel, a meal, rest. The touring days start the next morning. After that the days stay on a short loop: Dead Sea (3 days). It's a hot month, so the outdoor sites go before midday.
assumptions: Travel times between cities are estimated qualitatively, not as exact minutes, unless evidence exists.
Opening hours are used only when present on the catalog record.

climate.typical_pattern: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
climate.outdoor_guidance: Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

decisions.title: Each exploring day stays in one area
decisions.why: Mixing far-apart cities in one day makes the trip exhausting.
decisions.effect: After arrival, the days run Dead Sea (3 days).

decisions.title: Night one is near the airport
decisions.effect: Sleep in Aqaba on arrival night. The exploring days start the next morning.

decisions.title: You land in the south, then move north
decisions.why: King Hussein / Aqaba is the arrival airport, but the trip is for North or Central Jordan.
decisions.effect: Sleep in Aqaba on night one, then relocate before the main exploring days.

decisions.title: Settle in this evening
decisions.effect: Food and rest first. A nearby stop only if enough evening remains, then back to the hotel.

decisions.title: Then you move closer to the places you came for
decisions.why: Sleeping in the same city you visit beats a long commute every morning.
decisions.effect: After the arrival night, nearby days share one hotel. You only move when the next area is too far for a day trip.

decisions.title: Mornings for the outdoors
decisions.why: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
decisions.effect: Walk heritage and nature in the morning. Save museums, meals, and shade for the afternoon.

decisions.title: A relaxed pace
decisions.effect: On exploring days, plan on about 2 visits and 3 meals. Arrival follows the time left after food and rest.

decisions.title: 4 star stays
decisions.effect: Hotels are taken from listings at that star level when the city has them. If it does not, we use the closest listed tier and say so.

decisions.title: A comfort budget
decisions.effect: We lean toward more comfortable stays and dining when those places exist.

decisions.title: Chosen around what you care about
decisions.effect: Stops follow nature, food, and photography. Unrelated places stay off the list.
